title: Monthly management close
context: Financial Controller closing the March 2026 management accounts. Proposed change: a duplicate check after the split export, a stop on unmapped accounts, and an explicit rule for unexplained variances.
origin: Curated synthetic candidate for the hackathon (fictional data). Not approved: review every step in the desk.

evidence.text: Reports > GL detail export. Period 2026-03. Exported 01/03-14/03 and 15/03-31/03 separately (timeout workaround).
Merged into gl_2026-03.csv: 63 rows. Checked that no entry of 14 March appears twice.
closing_workbook_2026-03.xlsx, tab GL_import: deleted February rows, pasted 63 March rows.
Filter column M on UNMAPPED: 6 rows, account 4020 Sales - online web shop, total 6,400.00. PnL_vs_Budget shows FIX MAPPING.
Read Ellen Walsh's email: account 4020 opened on 1 March for the new web shop, not in the mapping tab yet.
Tab Mapping: added account 4020 -> REV_ONLINE (Revenue - Online). UNMAPPED now returns 0 rows.
Check: sum of net in GL_import matches the ERP P&L total for March. OK.
Tab PnL_vs_Budget refreshed. EBITDA actual 276,900 vs budget 324,000. Comment needed = YES on 7 lines.
GL_import filtered on account 5000, Brightwood Timber Ltd: 3 invoices, price list 2026-02, total 162,000.00. Same cause as February.
Searched mail for 'Belvedere', 'StaffBridge', 'Celtic', 'KPC', 'Atlantic'. Found E06, E07, E09, E10, E11, E14.
Atlantic Freight: 3 lines 'Surcharge - service code EXP', 6,200.00 in total. No email or chat explains why. Left as open question.
Tab Commentary: wrote explanations for 7 lines above threshold, with sources.
management_pack_2026-03.pptx: updated Summary, P&L vs budget and Variance commentary slides.

steps.text: Export the GL detail for the month from the ERP, P&L accounts 4000 to 6999.
Check that no entry appears twice after merging the split export (duplicate entry_id).
steps.quote: Checked that no entry of 14 March appears twice.

steps.text: Replace last month's rows in the GL_import tab with the new export.
If an account shows UNMAPPED, stop before calculating anything.
steps.quote: Filter column M on UNMAPPED: 6 rows, account 4020

steps.text: Find out what the new account is and confirm with the GL owner.
steps.quote: account 4020 opened on 1 March for the new web shop

steps.text: Add the account to the Mapping tab, then check that UNMAPPED returns 0 rows.
Check that the sum of net in GL_import equals the ERP P&L total.
steps.quote: sum of net in GL_import matches the ERP P&L total

steps.text: Refresh PnL_vs_Budget and list the lines where comment needed = YES.
For each of these lines, filter GL_import by account and counterparty, and compare with last month's explanation.
Search mail, chat and meeting notes for the cause.
If no source explains a variance, say so and ask the owner. Never invent a cause.
steps.quote: No email or chat explains why. Left as open question.

steps.text: Write the explanation in the Commentary tab: cause, whether it repeats next month, and the source.
steps.quote: wrote explanations for 7 lines above threshold, with sources

steps.text: Update the management pack slides from the workbook.
steps.quote: updated Summary, P&L vs budget and Variance commentary slides

questions.question: Should the duplicate entry_id check run on every export, or only when the split workaround is used?
